sprite_semantics.crop_rice_seedling.png: Stage 0 (seedling): sparse GRASS_LT 2px sprout dots on DIRT_MD/DIRT_DK tilled base. Pale + sparse — barely-there, fully recedes. 5 unique colours (transparent + 4 palette). No outline.
sprite_semantics.crop_rice_growing.png: Stage 1 (growing): 4-column stalks GRASS_DK (lower) -> GRASS_MD (mid body) -> GRASS_LT (tip) with 1px OUTLINE_PLANT cap. 1px left/right leaf spread at mid-height. Muted green — recedes below pawn saturation. 7 unique colours.
sprite_semantics.crop_rice.png: Stage 2 (ripe / canonical slot): GRASS_DK stalks + CROP_GOLD grain head cluster (tip + mid + side beads). DIRT_MD lower bead shadow (palette-legal). CROP_GOLD is the ONLY saturated accent. 6 unique colours. Unmistakably gold, pops.
